titulo: DEVO v2 — cosmético em duas etapas: casulo fechado e asas abertas
prompt: Ornate jewelry object concept art, painted, highly detailed, isolated on a plain flat light grey background, front view, symmetrical, soft studio light with bright specular highlights. A small gothic reliquary emblem of champagne gold filigree and black enamel with amethyst gems, about the size of a brooch. No text, letters or logos anywhere.
negative: text, letters, watermark, person, cartoon, flat vector, blurry, low detail, insect body, bug

variacoes.prompt_extra: Stage one: a closed cocoon-shaped locket wrapped in folded metal petals like sleeping wings, tightly shut, a single amethyst glowing faintly through a seam.
Stage two: the same locket opened, two large spread wings of gold filigree and violet stained glass unfolding to both sides, a bright amethyst heart in the center, tiny sparks.
